entities.summary: Valeriy Illich Konovalyuk is a Ukrainian politician who was a People's Deputy of Ukraine from 1998 to 2006 and from 2007 to 2012, first from Ukraine's 62nd electoral district in Donetsk Oblast and later on the proportional representative list of the Party of Regions. Konovalyuk was a candidate in the 2014 Ukrainian presidential election, in which he gathered 0.38% of the vote.
